text:
alex: Heads-up — nightly evals (master) show a clear uptick in sampling divergence starting 2026-03-19 build. Noise in the Top-k/top-p distributions, failing ~12 prompt tests compared to yesterday. cc @maria @devon
maria: saw the alert. Is this tied to the attn-fastpath change that landed in #3245? our perf tests passed but eval diffs look bad.
devon: possibly. #3245 reordered a matmul + softmax kernel to use fused softmax; there was also a small change to RNG seeding in sampler.cu to avoid contention.
sasha: I dumped two sample generations (same seed) from yesterday vs today. here are short excerpts:
```
PROMPT: "Write a one-sentence summary of climate change impacts."
BEFORE: "Climate change accelerates extreme weather, shifts ecosystems, and threatens food security worldwide."
AFTER: "Climate change is a big problem that affects weather and things and is bad for crops."
```
small but clear style/quality drop.
eva: interesting — I also saw hallucination increase on QA prompts where the model used to cite numbers. Likely sampling randomness got biased toward shorter tokens/stop sequences.
ci-bot: nightly-evals/master: 2026-03-19T06:12Z — 12 failing prompts (+9 severity), regression introduced between commits abc123..def456. Full diff: https://ci.internal/reports/1799994321
devon: quick bisect idea: the candidate is abc->def range. I suspect the RNG seed relocation from global to per-thread changed the PRNG stream interleaving when fused-attn reorder triggers different kernel call counts. That can change sampling tie-breakers.
maria: can we reproduce locally with the same seeds? try running eval_runner with deterministic flags.
sasha: running now with
```bash
python tests/eval_runner.py --model redwood/4k --prompts eval/qa_set.json --seed 42 --deterministic --disable-fused-attn
```
will post results.
(2m later)
sasha: disabling fused-attn makes the outputs match baseline again. with fused-attn=on we diverge. That matches the kernel call count hypothesis.
alex: so it's not quantization per se, it's ordering/side-effect on RNG. Might only affect some models or seq len distributions where fused path used.
eva: impact matrix: affects hosted and dedicated with newer runtime. Private deployments with older runtime unaffected.
devon: short-term mitigation: revert the RNG relocation or make the sampler use an explicit per-request PRNG instance (CSPRNG or keyed counter) so kernel call order doesn't alter stream. Longer-term: add deterministic sampling mode in runtime.
maria: can we do a canary rollout that disables fused-attn for the most-used SKU and run full eval set? I can create the job.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT-2026-03-19-01 created: sampling-output-regression. Pager on-call: devon. Severity: P2.
devon: I'll open a hotfix PR to pin RNG to a per-request Philox stream (proposal in the PR description). PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/3299 — includes tests to assert identical outputs with/without fused-attn for fixed seed.
sasha: added a failing test reproducer under tests/regressions/test_sampling_repro.py with the prompt that showed the style drop.
ci-bot: build 3299-eval: running nightly evals; ETA ~20m.
alex: action items: (1) devon to review+merge hotfix if CI green; (2) maria to run canary disabling fused-attn for small cohort; (3) sasha to expand regression prompts and add to blocked set; (4) ops to pause broad rollout until resolved.
maria: noted, starting canary job now.
devon: quick note — we should consider seeding sampler at higher entropy (seed + request id) to avoid interleaving issues. but keep deterministic flag for tests.
eva: also add a monitoring check for token distribution shifts (avg token length, stop-token frequency) so we catch similar silent regressions early.
alex: thanks all. keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
